title: Open-Legal-Products/mike
why_good: An open-source legal-AI platform — legal is a huge, high-willingness-to-pay vertical where an open, self-hostable option appeals to firms wary of cloud.
value: Sell hosted + compliance + firm-specific tuning to law firms and in-house legal; legal budgets are large and sticky.
risk: Legal AI demands accuracy and liability guarantees; incumbents (Harvey, CoCounsel) are well-funded and trusted.
pick_reason: The platform provides a clear product that can be monetized by offering affordable legal resources for small businesses.

zh.claim: Open-Legal-Products/mike —— 开源法律 AI 平台。
zh.why_good: 一个开源法律 AI 平台——法律是个大、高付费意愿的垂直,开源可自托管对忌惮云的律所有吸引力。
zh.value: 向律所和法务卖托管 + 合规 + 事务所定制;法律预算大且黏。
zh.risk: 法律 AI 要准确性和责任担保;现有玩家(Harvey、CoCounsel)有钱且被信任。
